text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I... won?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer...
choice_data_list: すごいぞ、よく頑張ったな！
すごいよ、よく頑張ったね！

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: That's right... Yeah! I...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I really did it! I won!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Sniffle... sniffle... Waaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Special Week bawls her eyes out as we
celebrate
her victory. The crowd
continues to cheer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And then...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Sniff... Aw, my eyes are gonna be so puffy tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Promise not to laugh if my face looks all
weird,
okay?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe. You're so kind, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hm? My phone?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Oh! It's my mom!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: H-hello?! Uh-huh... Yeah, uh-huh!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I see. So you watched the Derby?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Mmhmm... Yep. With the photo of my
birth mom
too...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: How was I, Mom? You know what? I...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I've improved a bit, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Without hearing the response, I could
tell by her
face exactly what her mother
said.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's probably exhausted, so after the
call, I
decide to take her back to her
dorm. But...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Uh, Trainer? How about we go grab
something to
eat now? If you're up for it,
that is.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah, there's that. But there's also
another
thing to celebrate today...
choice_data_list: ダービー勝利のお祝いに？

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: You becoming a Derby trainer!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Let's order whatever we want and eat as
much as
we can together!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hehe! It's not always just about the food when it comes to me.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Say, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: How... did I do today?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
choice_data_list: 誇りに思えるウマ娘だったぞ
誇りに思えるウマ娘だったよ

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It makes me so happy to hear you say
that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Special Week's sparkling eyes grow
narrow as a
smile spreads across her
face.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
All righty! Let's eat a ton of delicious
food, then
get right back to work
tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: C'mon, Trainer!
